Hostile page

This paragraph carries an inline handler, a style and a class. It is long enough that Readability treats it as content, which matters for the extraction tests.

Script link Relative link Protocol-relative link Mail the editor Data link

Hostile pages still carry real writing, and the extractor has to keep it while it throws away everything that could run code or phone home. This paragraph exists to give the page enough plain prose that it reads as an article, so that the tests below exercise the same Readability path a real article would take, rather than the full-page fallback, which treats the page as text and would hide whether links and images are resolved correctly.
